title: Sell your jewellery
subtitle: Upload photos of the piece, enter the net gold weight and purity, and see the indicative payout at today's sell-in rate. Our team will review and confirm an offer.
heroDesc: Share photos, net weight, and pickup details. Optional invoice helps us verify purity faster. The live estimate is indicative until we inspect the piece.
netWeightHint: Weight of gold only, excluding stones if you know them. We will confirm after inspection.
notesPlaceholder: Hallmark, stones, condition, or anything that helps us evaluate the piece.
imagesHint: Upload 1–5 photos (JPG, PNG, WebP). Include a hallmark close-up if possible.
invoiceHint: Upload a purchase invoice or bill if you have one (JPG, PNG, WebP, or PDF).
locationDenied: Location permission was denied. Enter coordinates manually.
locationUnavailable: Could not read your location. Enter coordinates or continue without them.
needLogin: Sign in to send a sell jewellery request.
noRequests: You have not sent a sell request yet.
indicativeHint: Based on today's sell-in rate. Final offer may change after inspection.
noLiveRate: Sell-in rate for this purity is not set yet. Please try again later.

replyPlaceholder: Reply with the extra details requested…
